content_review.notes: Medium staff break-room function is apparent: three lockers, microwave/hot-drink counter, shared table/bench, clock and bulletin board. An extra potted plant and waste bin were generated. Front/south is visibly open; actual walkable clearance is not measured.

alpha.notes: Checkerboard composite shows transparent exterior and no obvious broad opaque background. But the entire nontransparent subject is semitransparent and no pixel reaches alpha 255; opacity/edge behavior must be inspected in game before adoption. Independent visual review also sees a broad dark outer blur and semitransparent edge; inspect against actual game backgrounds.

projection_and_shape.visual_notes: Single 3/4 cutaway with open front. The layout reads wider than deep, but several visible edge slopes appear inconsistent with strict 2:1 axes. No control-point measurement was taken; do not treat prompt compliance as projection proof. Independent reviewer finds the floor plausibly 3x2 but cannot confirm the world axes or south orientation.

unverified: strict iso2x_v1 X/Y slopes and vertical scale
south access clearance and interaction path
recommended_action: Keep as review-only. Inspect the broad semitransparent edge over actual game backgrounds, measure floor/wall control points against 3x2 iso2x_v1 and fixture dimensions, and verify anchor/access/readability in Godot. Preserve the original; no stretching or mirroring.

findings: Content: pass by visual inspection; lockers, microwave, kettle and shared table read as a staff room.
South opening: likely open at the near side, but the image has no compass; south orientation is not independently verified.
Alpha: transparent corners/background confirmed; dark outer blur and broad semitransparent edge remain a concern on game backgrounds.
Projection/scale: isometric-looking and floor plausibly resembles 3x2, but iso2x_v1 angles and 2.92x1.92x2.4m dimensions are not verified.
Game readability: furniture is clear at source size; fine details may be hard to read at game zoom, which was not tested.
